Dearest Traveler,

Shinshu is the land of high mountains, cold pristine rivers, and silent valleys in Nagano. Here, the formidable peaks of the Japanese Alps rise like giant sleeping dragons, their snowy summits touching the clouds. In the cold winter, wild snow monkeys gather in the steaming thermal pools of Jigokudani, their red faces relaxed in the rising mist.

In the ancient halls of Zenko-ji temple, visitors touch the wooden pillars worn smooth by millions of hands over fourteen centuries, seeking a connection to the eternal. Shinshu reminds us to seek height, to look beyond the valleys of our daily worries, and to keep our inner fires burning even in the deepest winter.

With mountain clarity,
Kokoro of Shinshu
